data.name: Fire
data.description: One of the four elements infuses your being, and you can draw upon its power in times of need. At first level, you must select one of the four elements: air, earth, fire, or water. This choice cannot be changed. A number of your abilities grant resistances and deal damage based on your element. Fire is associate with the Fire energy type and the base movement type (+30 feet base speed).
